The award winning All-in-One Carry-On, designed to be more than a rolling box to store your things in. The perfect mix of efficiency and style.

Stay powered on-the-go with a built-in multi USB/USB-C port, no more desperately searching for an outlet at your gate. Breeze through security and effortlessly pull your laptop out of  the zipperless front pocket fitting laptops up to 16" in size. Not to worry, your essentials stay protected with a TSA approved combination lock. Did we mention that there's no need to frantically look for your things, NOBL has you covered with a passport sleeve and a waterproof pocket for your toiletries. Feel free to shop before your flight and hang your shopping bags on the crafted rubber studs. Finally, sit down and enjoy your pre-flight beverage, keeping your hands completely free with the built-in cup holder as you wait to board your flight. Your adventure starts here.

description.plain:
Description

Meet the Carry-On Pro Plus, the larger and upgraded sibling of our award-winning Carry-On. Featuring a built-in front compartment for easy access to your travel essentials, the Carry-On Pro Plus is designed for seamless, functional travel. Fits a 16" laptop and keeps it protected under the same aerospace-grade polycarbonate as the rest of the case. Designed to fit in the luggage sizers and overhead bins of major US airlines.

Outfitted with a high-quality polycarbonate shell, the Carry-On Pro Plus is dent-resistant, impact-friendly and virtually unbreakable. It features an ultra-sturdy telescopic handle, TSA-Accepted lock, whisper-quiet wheels, vegan leather details, and all-premium materials. When you’re not travelling, the Carry-On Pro Plus suitcase nests inside any of our Check-In sizes for easy storage.

Features

Front pocket:

  • Aerospace-grade, water-resistant polycarbonate hard shell made from partially recycled materials
  • Lockable YKK zipper allows you to secure important items in the front pocket with your own lock
  • Three interior pockets can fit a 16" laptop, tablets, or magazines
  • Interior zippered pouch fits a phone, passport, and other small travel essentials

Suitcase:

  • Aerospace-grade, water-resistant polycarbonate hard shell made from partially recycled materials
  • High performance 360° spinner wheels
  • Luxuriously soft, anti-microbial lining, made from 100% recycled polyester
  • Adjustable telescopic handle with 4 height settings
  • Ultra-microfibre vegan leather details
  • TSA-Accepted combination lock
  • Colour-coordinated YKK reverse coil zippers
  • Built-in, removable compression pad with zippered pocket for flat items

Care and cleaning

Wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth, warm water, and mild soap. Use the included eco-friendly eraser for persistent marks. Air dry completely and store in the included dust bag when not in use. For added protection, our durable luggage covers help guard against dirt and scuffs.

Includes anti-microbial, silver ion-coated laundry bag and two shoe bags, plus vegan leather luggage tag.

Learn more about our quality

Specs
  • 3—7 days trip length
  • Weight: 8.10 lb / 3.67 kg
  • Volume: 42 L

Designed with comfort and convenience in mind, the Carry-On Companion Luggage is built from a durable, lightweight polycarbonate shell and sized to meet carry-on requirements, so it's ready for anything from a weekend getaway to a long-haul adventure.

  • Polycarbonate shell: lightweight and durable, built to protect your belongings
  • 360° spinner wheels: smooth, effortless maneuvering through any terminal
  • Ergonomic handle: a comfortable grip for quick moves between gates
  • Expandable interior: extra room when you need to pack just one more outfit
  • Interior compartments: organized packing, fuss-free every time
  • TSA-approved lock: secure travel with an easy 3-digit combination

Perfect for tropical vacations and honeymoons to work trips and everything in between.

How to unlock:

  1. Set the dials to 000
  2. Slide the small release lever (left of the dials) to the right
  3. Pull the zipper tabs—they should release from the lock
